# Default-registry detection cases, read by tests/providers_config.rs.
# Format: <provider|none>  <host/path>  # reason
# `none` means no provider may match. The host is everything before the first `/`.

# OpenAI regional domains
openai     us.api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions  # US data residency domain
openai     eu.api.openai.com/v1/responses  # EU data residency domain
openai     ae.api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions  # UAE data residency domain

# Cloud endpoints: Anthropic
anthropic  aws-external-anthropic.us-west-2.api.aws/v1/messages  # Claude Platform on AWS
anthropic  bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/anthropic/v1/messages  # Bedrock Mantle Anthropic route
anthropic  aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/p/locations/global/publishers/anthropic/models/claude-opus-5-5:rawPredict  # Vertex Claude, global
anthropic  us-east5-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/p/locations/us-east5/publishers/anthropic/models/claude-sonnet-4-6:streamRawPredict  # Vertex Claude, regional stream
anthropic  aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com/v1/projects/p/locations/eu/publishers/anthropic/models/claude-opus-5-5:rawPredict  # Vertex Claude, multi-region
anthropic  claude.googleapis.com/v1/projects/p/locations/global/workspaces/wrkspc_01/invoke/v1/messages  # Claude on Google Cloud
anthropic  myres.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic/v1/messages  # Claude in Microsoft Foundry

# Cloud endpoints: OpenAI-compatible
openai     bedrock-mantle.us-east-2.api.aws/openai/v1/responses  # Bedrock Mantle Responses
openai     bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/v1/chat/completions  # Bedrock Mantle chat

openai     bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/openai/v1/chat/completions  # Bedrock Runtime OpenAI chat
openai     bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/openai/v1/responses  # Bedrock Runtime OpenAI Responses
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-4o/chat/completions?api-version=2024-10-21  # Azure api-version chat
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-35-turbo-instruct/completions?api-version=2024-10-21  # Azure api-version legacy completions
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/responses?api-version=2025-04-01-preview  # Azure api-version Responses
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-4o/responses?api-version=2025-04-01-preview  # Azure Responses, client bound to a deployment
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/chat/completions  # Azure v1 chat
openai     myres.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses  # Azure v1 Responses
openai     myres.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses  # Foundry v1 Responses

# Cloud endpoints: Bedrock Runtime native
bedrock    bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/model/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0/converse  # Converse
bedrock    bedrock-runtime.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/model/us.anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1%3A0/invoke  # InvokeModel, Anthropic model, encoded colon

# Foundry: one host serves OpenAI and Anthropic routes, so only the path picks the provider
anthropic  myres.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic/v1/messages  # Foundry Anthropic route
anthropic  myres.services.ai.azure.com/anthropic/v1/messages/  # trailing slash
openai     myres.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1/chat/completions  # Foundry OpenAI chat
openai     myres.services.ai.azure.com/openai/v1/responses  # Foundry OpenAI Responses

# Responses retrieval
none       api.openai.com/v1/responses/resp_123  # GET a stored response
none       api.openai.com/v1/responses/resp_123/input_items  # list input items
none       api.openai.com/v1/responses/resp_123/cancel  # cancel a background response

# Generation endpoints
anthropic  api.anthropic.com/v1/messages  # Messages
anthropic  api.anthropic.com/v1/messages?beta=true  # query ignored by the anchor
anthropic  api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/  # trailing slash
anthropic  api.anthropic.com/anthropic/v1/messages  # proxy prefix
openai     api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions  # Chat Completions
openai     api.openai.com/v1/completions  # legacy completions
openai     api.openai.com/openai/deployments/d1/chat/completions?api-version=2026-10-01  # Azure-style path on any OpenAI host

# Non-generation endpoints
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/count_tokens  # token counting
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/count_tokens?beta=true  # token counting with query
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/batches  # create a batch
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/batches/msgbatch_01  # batch status
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/batches/msgbatch_01/results  # batch results
none       api.anthropic.com/v1/messages/batches/msgbatch_01/cancel  # batch cancel
none       api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions/chatcmpl-abc123  # stored completion
none       api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions/chatcmpl-abc123/messages  # stored completion messages

# Basic detection
openai     api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions  # OpenAI chat
gemini     generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1/models/gemini:generateContent  # Gemini API
